notes: Extracted by visual transcription of scanned NaCCA (2021) PDFs (image-only, no embedded text); pages rendered at 150 dpi and read as images. 'page' is the 1-based PDF page; for the Mathematics PDF the printed page number = PDF page + 163; for the Computing PDF printed page = PDF page + 39. Indicator codes follow the authoritative trackers (Grade9-Maths/LESSON_TRACKER.md, Grade9-Computing/Curriculum_Tracker.md); conflicts with the PDF are normalized as follows: (1) Maths PDF p.8 printed 'B9.1.2.3.4' -> recorded as B9.1.2.4.4 per Maths tracker. (2) Maths PDF typos 'B.9.1.2.1' (p.5) and 'B.9.3.2.1' (p.42) -> normalized to B9.1.2.1 and B9.3.2.1. (3) The Maths PDF skips content standard B9.1.2.3 entirely (goes B9.1.2.1, B9.1.2.2, B9.1.2.4), consistent with the tracker. (4) The Computing PDF renders codes with letter 'I' glyphs (e.g. 'B9I.I.I.I.I'); all normalized to the numeric tracker form (B9.1.1.1.1). Non-indicator pages excluded: Maths PDF p.1 (subject intro), p.58-66 (appendix: core competencies); Computing PDF p.1 (cover), p.18-24 (glossary/appendix core competencies), p.25-27 (references, panel members). No unreadable pages. All codes were cross-checked against the trackers; no tracker-indicated code is missing from the extraction (Maths 50 indicators; Computing 37 indicators).
